channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Deron Williams | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Deron Williams from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Yogi Ferrell on Deron Williams
item.description:
Dwain Price:Yogi Ferrell on Deron Williams:

“I know there’s always a business part of it. I love Deron. I learned some stuff from Deron.”

Yogi Ferrell on Deron Williams, Feb 24, 2017. Source: Twitter @DwainPrice.

item.title: Yogi Ferrell on Deron Williams
item.description:
Dwain Price:Yogi Ferrell on the #Mavs waiving Deron Williams:

“I'm a little bit shocked. He’s an All-Star guy. He's a great player.”

Yogi Ferrell on Deron Williams, Feb 24, 2017. Source: Twitter @DwainPrice.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Deron Williams
item.description:
Rick Carlisle on Deron Williams:

“It was great having Deron and his family back home in Dallas for the better part of 2 seasons. At this time the decision has been made to focus on playing our young guys, and the organization felt that giving Deron the freedom to choose his next team was the right thing to do. Deron still plays at a high level and I believe he will be a difference-maker for a contending team down the stretch of this season. We wish him and his family the very best.”

Rick Carlisle on Deron Williams, Feb 23, 2017. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Deron Williams
item.description:
Tim MacMahon:Rick Carlisle on Deron Williams:

“I'm glad to hear he's doing fine. ... It's good news. Thank you for that.”

Rick Carlisle on Deron Williams, Nov 4, 2016. Source: Twitter @espn_macmahon.

item.title: Devin Harris on Deron Williams
item.description:
Earl K. Sneed:Devin Harris on Deron Williams' likely pending free agency:

“I think he wants to be back. It just depends if it can happen.”

Devin Harris on Deron Williams, Jun 21, 2016. Source: Twitter @EarlKSneed.

item.title: Donnie Nelson on Deron Williams
item.description:
Earl K. Sneed:Donnie Nelson on Deron Williams:

“We would love to figure out a way to continue the ride with him as well.”

Donnie Nelson on Deron Williams, Apr 26, 2016. Source: Twitter @EarlKSneed.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Deron Williams
item.description:
Tim MacMahon:Rick Carlisle on Deron Williams:

“I thoroughly enjoyed working with him. ... Of course I'd like to see him back.”

Rick Carlisle on Deron Williams, Apr 26, 2016. Source: Twitter @espn_macmahon.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Deron Williams
item.description:
Dwain Price:Carlisle on Deron Williams' injured left ring finger:

“I am concerned about it but he says he’s doing OK. He tells me he’s going to play tomorrow.”

Rick Carlisle on Deron Williams, Feb 25, 2016. Source: Twitter @DwainPrice.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Deron Williams
item.description:
Tim MacMahon:Rick Carlisle on Deron Williams' right hip contusion:

“I don't know anything about a timetable or anything like that, but I'm concerned.”

Rick Carlisle on Deron Williams, Feb 1, 2016. Source: Twitter @espn_macmahon.

item.title: Lionel Hollins on Deron Williams
item.description:
Tom Lorenzo:Lionel Hollins:

“I have no comment about Deron Williams... I don't want to talk about Deron Williams, period.”

Lionel Hollins on Deron Williams, Dec 23, 2015. Source: Twitter @TomLorenzo.

item.title: Mark Cuban on Deron Williams
item.description:
Michael Scotto:Mark Cuban on Deron Williams:

“He’s been playing great. I’m glad it didn’t work out for him there (Brooklyn) and I’m glad he’s here.”

Mark Cuban on Deron Williams, Dec 7, 2015. Source: Twitter @MikeAScotto.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Devin Harris, Raymond Felton, Deron Williams, JJ Barea
item.description:
Dwain Price:Carlisle:

“We’re going 2 keep all our point guards. All those guys, Williams, Barea, Harris, Felton, those guys are going 2 be on the team.”

Rick Carlisle on Devin Harris, Raymond Felton, Deron Williams, JJ Barea, Oct 10, 2015. Source: Twitter @DwainPrice.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Deron Williams
item.description:
Tim MacMahon:Rick Carlisle on Deron Williams:

“I'm a long-time fan. When this situation popped up, it was almost like it was too good to be true.”

Rick Carlisle on Deron Williams, Jul 14, 2015. Source: Twitter @espn_macmahon.

item.title: Doc Rivers on Joe Johnson, Deron Williams
item.description:
“But I think they're still at the top of their games. I think Paul is still one of those guys who can go off for big nights and still have big scoring nights. Kevin is a culture change. He won't play but 20 to 25 minutes a night and there'll probably be nights when he doesn't play but his presence there alone will absolutely change the culture of Brooklyn. There's no doubt about it. I think for some of the young guys, even some of the veteran stars, Joe Johnson and Deron Williams, will learn and understand what a winner is and looks like and professionalism and being prepared.”

Doc Rivers on Joe Johnson, Deron Williams, Jul 28, 2013. Source: Boston Globe.

item.title: Reggie Evans on Deron Williams
item.description:
Reggie Evans:

“He's going to be beneficial to me and Deron Williams. It will be incredible for Deron to work with Jason because his knowledge is so vast. I'm most excited about the impact that it's going to have on Deron, because Deron's relationships with the other players is very important to the team's success. The relationship of two point guards of that caliber should help our team, because we'll all be able to feed off of them so much more. I'm very excited to continue to work with Deron under that kind of leadership.”

Reggie Evans on Deron Williams, Jun 15, 2013. Source: ESPN.com.

item.title: Mark Cuban on Deron Williams
item.description:
Mark Cuban, on whether he intentionally sabotaged the Mavs' efforts to sign Deron Williams because he preferred to make a run at free agents available this summer:

“Did you see that episode of Shark Tank I filmed that day? It was amazing!”

Mark Cuban on Deron Williams, May 25, 2013. Source: ESPN.com.

item.title: PJ Carlesimo on Deron Williams
item.description:
“Everybody else has problems with Deron. I don't have any problems with Deron Williams,”

PJ Carlesimo on Deron Williams, Feb 20, 2013. Source: ESPN.com.

item.title: Jerry Colangelo on Deron Williams
item.description:
Colangelo told Bondy,

“Deron Williams, for the Olympics, was not in the best shape. He was a little overweight, and I told him that at the time.”

Jerry Colangelo on Deron Williams, Feb 17, 2013. Source: NetsDaily.

item.title: Gary Payton on Deron Williams
item.description:
“He should be the rookie of the year, he’s playing very well right now for Portland and I love his game. “I’ve been watching Deron Williams for a long period of time now and I like him. He is the epitome of an old-school basketball player. He just goes out there and gets it done, he’s not about being fancy, going through your legs three or four times, pulling up in your face. He just gets it done. He just gets what he has to get, gets his assists, gets his rebounds, gets his points and just gets his team to win.”

Gary Payton on Deron Williams, Jan 17, 2013. Source: NBCSports.com.

item.title: Jerry Sloan on Deron Williams
item.description:
Ex-Jazz coachJerry Sloan on Deron Williams' praise of his system:

“There's really nothing to comment on. ... I just hope he's doing well.”

Jerry Sloan on Deron Williams, Dec 18, 2012. Source: Twitter @sluhm.

item.title: Billy King on Deron Williams
item.description:
“[Utah president] Kevin [O'Connor] made the decision to move [Williams] before [Williams] got frustrated and wanted out. When teams know they can't keep a guy, I think you're going to see them get ahead of it like [the Jazz] did. You'll see that more often. Hey, I wanted to move Allen sooner in Philadelphia than we did. I had a deal with Denver before that [2006-07] season, but their team was negotiating a sale so they couldn't do anything.”

Billy King on Deron Williams, Oct 2, 2012. Source: Yahoo! Sports.

item.title: Mark Cuban on Deron Williams
item.description:
“I don’t want to pick on Deron Williams because he’s a great, great, great, great player, so it’s not necessarily him per say,”

Mark Cuban on Deron Williams, Aug 21, 2012. Source: Dallas Morning News.

item.title: Jordan Crawford on Joe Johnson, Deron Williams
item.description:
Michael Lee:Jordan Crawford said BKN have NBA's best backcourt:

“Vicious. The only word to describe it. Deron [Williams] is like a 6-2 Joe Johnson.”

Jordan Crawford on Joe Johnson, Deron Williams, Jul 24, 2012. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Mikhail Prokhorov on Avery Johnson, Joe Johnson, Bobby Marks, Deron Williams, Billy King
item.description:
Prokhorov said in the statement.

“My congratulations and appreciation go out to general manager Billy King, assistant general manager Bobby Marks and head coach Avery Johnson for their tenacity, nerve and heart throughout this process. With the re-signing of Deron Williams and the trade for Joe Johnson, we go into our new home led by an All-Star backcourt and with every hope of a great season for the Brooklyn Nets. I can’t wait until opening night.”

Mikhail Prokhorov on Avery Johnson, Joe Johnson, Bobby Marks, Deron Williams, Billy King, Jul 13, 2012. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Mikhail Prokhorov on Joe Johnson, Bobby Marks, Deron Williams, Billy King
item.description:
Mikhail Prokhorov:

“I'm thrilled with the way our team has come together. My congratulations and appreciation go out to General Manager Billy King, Assistant General Manager Bobby Marks and Head Coach Avery Johnsonfor their tenacity, nerve and heart throughout this process. With the re-signing of Deron Williams and the trade for Joe Johnson, we go into our new home led by an All-Star backcourt and with every hope of a great season for the Brooklyn Nets. I can't wait until opening night.”

Mikhail Prokhorov on Joe Johnson, Bobby Marks, Deron Williams, Billy King, Jul 12, 2012. Source: Sulia.

item.title: Brendan Haywood on Deron Williams
item.description:
Brendan Haywood:

“You can’t go wrong with a player like Deron Williams. He’s a great player, but the only thing I’ve heard about him is he’s been feverously working out.”

Brendan Haywood on Deron Williams, Jun 15, 2012. Source: Dallas Morning News.

item.title: Billy King on Deron Williams
item.description:
“He said, ‘No, no, can’t do that. But let me look at that and I’ll get back to you.’ With all the things he said no to, he didn’t say no to Deron. So in my mind, I’m like, ‘OK, he didn’t say no to Deron and that’s what I’m trying to get.’ We went back and forth.“By four or five o’clock, (O’Connor) says, ‘Look, I talked to my owner, we have a deal, but I want to sleep on it. And it can’t get out.’ Very few people knew. But I told my wife. I said, ‘I think we’re going to get Deron Williams tomorrow.’ She didn’t believe me.”

Billy King on Deron Williams, Jun 3, 2012. Source: New York Daily News.

item.title: Jason Terry on Dwight Howard, Deron Williams
item.description:
“They didn't want to bring anybody back from last year…(Team officials said they're) clearing the cap as low and we can and this summer we're going after Dwight Howard, which hasn't happened, and Deron Williams, which they still have an opportunity.”

Jason Terry on Dwight Howard, Deron Williams, Mar 30, 2012. Source: FOXSports Florida.

item.title: Hidayet Turkoglu on Deron Williams
item.description:
Hedo Turkoglu on Deron Williams having his jersey retired by Besiktas:

“Maybe that was too much. Don't get me wrong, he's a great player, I respect his game but Besiktas should have done it with some Turkish players before him... He's the best player ever come to Turkey.”

Hidayet Turkoglu on Deron Williams, Jan 23, 2012. Source: Basket4Us.

item.title: Shaun Livingston on Chris Paul, Steve Nash, Deron Williams
item.description:
“At the time I got hurt was the evolution of Chris Paul and Deron Williams as point guards and Steve Nash was at the top of the totem pole for point guards,”

Shaun Livingston on Chris Paul, Steve Nash, Deron Williams, Dec 28, 2011. Source: Racine Journal-Times.
